subject.title: fix(voice-call): guard answered conversation calls when realtime config is absent

question: Should maintainers require real answered-call proof for this external voice-call fix, or accept the focused manager test and source evidence as sufficient?
rationale: The code change is narrow and source-supported, but the PR is external and the normal config loader usually supplies `realtime`, so only maintainer intent can waive the real-behavior proof gate.

options.title: Require real answered-call proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until the contributor adds a redacted live run, runtime log, terminal transcript, recording, or comparable provider-environment proof for an answered conversation call with omitted `realtime` config.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly waive live telephony proof and merge based on source inspection, focused regression coverage, and CI evidence.

options.title: Pause if reachability is too weak
options.body: If maintainers decide the missing-object state is not reachable enough to patch now, keep or close the PR without landing it.

recommendation.title: Require real answered-call proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until the contributor adds a redacted live run, runtime log, terminal transcript, recording, or comparable provider-environment proof for an answered conversation call with omitted `realtime` config.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the answered-call realtime short-circuit and has the strongest recent history on the voice-call manager/config/test surface.
